N, K = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def mat_mult(A, B):
    size = len(A)
    result = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            for k in range(size):
                result[i][j] = (result[i][j] + A[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD
    return result

# Read N and K
# Convert N to base K
base_k = []
temp_N = N
while temp_N:
    base_k.append(temp_N % K)
    temp_N //= K

# Initialize matrices A[0][i]
A = [[[[0]* (K+1) for _ in range(K+1)] for _ in range(30)] for _ in range(65)]
P = [[[[0]* (K+1) for _ in range(K+1)] for _ in range(30)] for _ in range(65)]
S = [[[[0]* (K+1) for _ in range(K+1)] for _ in range(30)] for _ in range(65)]
res = [[0]*(K+1) for _ in range(K+1)]

# Build initial matrices A[0][i]
for i in range(K):
    for j in range(K+1):
        A[0][i][j][j] = 1
    for j in range(K+1):
        A[0][i][i][j] = 1

# Build matrices for each digit in base_k
for i in range(1, len(base_k)):
    # P[i-1][j]
    P[i-1][0] = A[i-1][0]
    for j in range(1, K):
        P[i-1][j] = mat_mult(P[i-1][j-1], A[i-1][j])
    # S[i-1][j]
    S[i-1][K-1] = A[i-1][K-1]
    for j in range(K-2, -1, -1):
        S[i-1][j] = mat_mult(A[i-1][j], S[i-1][j+1])
    # A[i][j]
    for j in range(K):
        A[i][j] = S[i-1][j]
        if j > 0:
            A[i][j] = mat_mult(A[i][j], P[i-1][j-1])

# Initialize result matrix res as identity
for i in range(K+1):
    res[i][i] = 1

x = 0
for digit in reversed(base_k):
    for _ in range(digit):
        # Multiply res by A[i][x]
        res = mat_mult(res, A[x][x])
        x = (x + 1) % K

ans = 0
for i in range(K+1):
    ans = (ans + res[i][K]) % MOD

print(ans)
